21.9.2026
INTERVIEWS FOR THE POST OF MTS-(CLERK/DATA ENTRY
OPERATOR) AT UILS
This is in continuation of the advertisement for the post of MTS (Clerk/Data
Entry Operator) at UILS dated 11.9.2026 (copy placed below).
This is to further inform that the interview for the above-said posts will be
held on 5th October, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. in the office of Director, University
Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Salary: The salary for the above-said posts will be as per PU norms i.e.
24,494/- per month
Note: List of eligible candidates will be uploaded on notice board of uils
website.
Sd/-
Director
